Shilka tareen ee Spain oo sababay in la hakiyo dhamaan ciyaarihii loo balansanaa
Published
Waqtiga akhriska: 3 daqiiqo
Dhammaan 24-ka kulan ee Copa del Rey-ga Spain oo dhici lahaa Arbacada ayaa la hakiyay iyadoo la tixgelinayo ixtiraamka ugu yaraan 68 qof oo ku dhintay shil tareen oo ka dhacay meel u dhow Madrid.
In ka badan 500 oo rakaab ah ayaa ku safrayay tareenada markii ay isku dhaceen oo ay ka baxeen qadka.
War-saxaafadeed ay soo saartay xiriirka kubadda cagta Spain (RFEF), mas'uuliyiintu waxay sheegeen in go'aanka loo gaaray si wadajir ah oo lala shaqeeyo dhibanayaasha.
Shan kooxood oo heerka koowaad ah, Levante, Alaves, Valencia, Celta Vigo iyo Real Betis ayaa la filayay inay ciyaaraan kulamada wareega koowaad Arbacada.
Kooxaha waaweyn ee Spain oo ay ku jiraan Real Madrid, Barcelona iyo Atletico Madrid ayaan la fileynin inay ka qayb galaan tartanka ilaa wareega 32-ka ee ugu dambeeya.
Barcelona waxay "tacsi tiiraanyo leh" u dirtay dadkii ku dhintay shilka baraha bulshada.
"FC Barcelona waxay tacsi tiiraanyo leh u diraysaa dadkii ku dhintay shilkii tareenka ee halista ahaa ee ka dhacay inta u dhaxaysa Los Yebenes iyo Urda (Toledo).
"Kooxdu waxay taageero iyo midnimo u diraysaa qoysaska iyo asxaabta dhibanayaasha, waxayna u rajaynaysaa dhammaan dadkii ku dhaawacmay inay si dhakhso ah u bogsadaan."
Warbixinada qotada dheer iyo wararka BBC Somali oo toos kuugu imanaaya WhatsApp.
Halkaan kaga soo biir
Dhamaadka xayeysiinta
Real Madrid waxay boggeeda internetka ku qortay inay "taageero buuxda" u fidineyso adeegyada gurmadka degdegga ah.
"Real Madrid C. F. waxay rabtaa inay muujiso murugada ay ka qabto shilkii tareenka ee naxdinta lahaa ee ka dhacay gobolka Toledo.
"Kooxdu waxay tacsi u diraysaa qoysaska iyo kuwa ay jecel yihiin dadkii naftooda ku waayay, iyo sidoo kale kalgacalka iyo wadajirka ay u hayso dadkii dhaawacmay iyo dhammaan dadkii ay saameysay shilkan xun."
Laba tareen ayaa isku dhacay Spain, taasoo keentay dhimashada dadkaan, inkastoo ay jirto cabsi laga qabo in tirada dhimashada dhabta ah ay aad uga badan karto.
Kooxaha gurmadka degdegga ah ayaa goobta jooga si ay u caawiyaan dadka dhaawacmay una raadiyaan kuwa badbaaday.
Shilku wuxuu dhacay markii tareen xawaare sare leh oo ka safrayay Madrid una socday koonfurta dalka uu ku dhacay tareen kale oo taagnaa. Shilku wuxuu sababay in ugu yaraan laba rimoor oo ka mid ahaa tareenada in ay ku dhacaan meel u dhow wadada.
Dab-damiska, dhakhaatiirta gurmadka degdegga ah iyo mas'uuliyiin kale oo samatabbixin ah ayaa goobta jooga, iyadoo saddex diyaaradood oo helikobtar ah sidoo kale loo isticmaalayo hawlaha samatabbixinta.
Sida laga soo xigtay wararka, dowladdu waxay aaminsan tahay in khaladaadka dadka ee la xiriira nidaamka calaamadaynta tareenka ay sababi karaan shilka.
Shirkadda tareenka qaranka ee Renfe ayaa diyaarisay lambar taleefan oo gaar ah oo loogu talagalay qaraabada dadkii saarnaa tareenada si ay u helaan macluumaad.
Baarlamaanka Spain ayaa dib u dhigay dhammaan hawlihii loo qorsheeyay maanta.
Ra'iisul Wasaare Pedro Sánchez ayaa baraha bulshada ku qoray inuu ka xun yahay warkaas, isagoo tacsi u diraya isla markaana ballan qaadaya taageero iyo midnimo loo fidinayo dadkii dhaawacmay iyo qoysaskooda.
Bishii Janaayo, shil ay isku dhaceen laba tareen oo isku xariiq ku socday ayaa sababay dhimashada 46 qof.

Relief measures have been stepped up in Nagapattinam district following heavy rainfall owing to the northeast monsoon between October 1 and 27, Minister for Minorities Welfare A.M. Shahjahan said on Wednesday.
Accompanied by Collector K. J. Praveen Kumar, he inspected a cyclone protection centre at Pazhaiyanampiyar Nagar in Nagapattinam, precautionary measures at Akkaraipettai harbour, emergency communication equipment used by fishermen, and a veterinary medical camp at Kadampur.
Rain-related damage had been reported to 23 houses in the district. Relief assistance totalling ₹1.78 lakh had been distributed, including ₹26,000 for four fully damaged houses and ₹1.52 lakh for 19 partially damaged huts. Compensation of ₹3.60 lakh has been provided for the loss of 21 animals in rain-related incidents.
A 24-hour emergency response and flood-control room is functioning at the Collectorate, with officials from various departments working in shifts. Action has been taken on 31 complaints received at the control room, Mr. Shahjahan said.
The Fire and Rescue Services department had conducted 77 mock drills while teams had been formed at the taluk level to coordinate evacuation, search and rescue operations, and the maintenance of relief shelters.
Of the 392 fair price shops in the district, 214 in vulnerable areas had been stocked with an additional 25% of essential commodities as a precaution against the monsoon.
Meanwhile, 106 special fever camps were conducted across the district between October 17 and 27 to prevent the spread of seasonal diseases. A total of 2,707 people underwent medical examinations, and 84 people with fever symptoms were provided treatment and medicines.
The Animal Husbandry Department conducted 20 special veterinary camps, benefiting 247 farmers. Medical treatment was provided to 16,529 animals, including 4,369 cows, 5,926 goats and 6,127 hens.
The Water Resources Department has taken up desilting work across the district to facilitate the free flow of rainwater. These include 20 works covering 112.10 km under the Thanjavur Cauvery Basin Division, 36 works covering 280.30 km under the Tiruvarur Vennar Basin Division, and one work covering 7 km under the Pattukkottai Agniyar Basin Division, Mr. Shahjahan added.

New Delhi, Oct 28 (PTI) Delhi’s air quality deteriorated to the poor category on Wednesday, with the Air Quality Index (AQI) settling at 229, while the India Meteorological Department (IMD) issued a yellow alert for moderate rain on Thursday.
The weather department has forecast a generally cloudy sky with moderate rain on Thursday, with the minimum and maximum temperatures likely to settle at 17 degrees Celsius and 27 degrees Celsius, respectively. For Friday, it has forecast thunderstorms with rain.
According to the IMD, the maximum temperature at Safdarjung, Delhi’s base weather station, settled at 31.8 degrees Celsius on Wednesday, 0.8 degrees above normal, while the minimum temperature was recorded at 15.7 degrees Celsius, 0.4 degrees below normal.
At Palam, the maximum temperature settled at 28.6 degrees Celsius, 3 degrees below normal, while the minimum was 15.5 degrees Celsius, 1.5 degrees below normal.
Lodhi Road recorded a maximum temperature of 31 degrees Celsius, at the normal level, and a minimum of 16.2 degrees Celsius, 1.2 degrees above normal.
The Ridge recorded a maximum temperature of 31.6 degrees Celsius, 0.7 degrees above normal, while the minimum was 16.5 degrees Celsius, 0.8 degrees below normal.
Ayanagar recorded a maximum temperature of 30.9 degrees Celsius, 0.1 degrees below normal, and a minimum of 14.8 degrees Celsius, 1.5 degrees below normal.
No rainfall was recorded at any of the five weather stations between 8.30 am and 5.30 pm on Wednesday, according to the IMD.
The city’s AQI stood at 229 on Wednesday, up from 197 on Tuesday, ending a four-day streak of moderate air quality, according to the Central Pollution Control Board (CPCB).
Of the 58 monitoring stations in the city, Vivek Vihar recorded the worst air quality, with an AQI of 316 in the very poor category. Sixteen stations recorded moderate air quality, while the remaining 41 were in the poor category.
Earlier this month, Delhi recorded poor air quality on October 21, when the AQI stood at 245, followed by 223 on October 22 and 230 on October 23. The air quality subsequently remained in the moderate category for four consecutive days before deteriorating again on Wednesday.
The Air Quality Early Warning System for Delhi has forecast that air quality is likely to remain in the moderate category from October 29 to October 31. However, the outlook for the subsequent six days suggests it could range between moderate and poor.
The system said a ventilation index below 6,000 square metres per second, coupled with an average wind speed of less than 10 kilometres per hour, is unfavourable for the dispersion of pollutants.
According to the Decision Support System for Air Quality Management in Delhi, the transport sector contributed 19.3 per cent of the city’s pollution on Wednesday. Delhi’s energy sector contributed 5 per cent, industries in Delhi and peripheral areas 4.8 per cent, residential sources 5.1 per cent, construction 2.5 per cent, waste burning 1.8 per cent, road dust 1.3 per cent and other sectors 1.3 per cent.
Among NCR districts, Ghaziabad contributed 11.8 per cent, Gautam Buddh Nagar 8.7 per cent, Meerut 8.6 per cent, Muzaffarnagar 5.7 per cent, Baghpat 4.2 per cent, Bulandshahr 3.9 per cent, Faridabad 3.06 per cent, Gurugram 2.1 per cent, Sonipat 1.5 per cent and Jhajjar 0.5 per cent. Stubble burning contributed 0.9 per cent, while other sources accounted for up to 9.6 per cent.
The Indian Agricultural Research Institute (IARI) said in its daily report that satellites detected 129 farm fire incidents across six states on October 27. Of these, 33 incidents were detected in Punjab, one in Haryana, 18 in Uttar Pradesh, 46 in Rajasthan, seven in Uttarakhand and 24 in Madhya Pradesh.
Between September 15 and October 27, satellites detected a total of 2,267 residue-burning events across the six states.
